prompts.animation:
Single continuous 4-second cinematic shot. Preserve the exact composition, characters, room layout, lighting, camera position, wardrobe, props, and scale from the source image.

Czesław and Halinka remain seated behind the table and suddenly hear one powerful, heavy thud from somewhere above the ceiling. They do not speak. Both react with restrained, realistic micro-expressions: their eyes shift upward first, then their heads tilt slightly toward the ceiling. Czesław’s brows lift and tighten with cautious concern; Halinka’s expression changes from calm to quietly worried, with a subtle widening of the eyes and slight tension in her jaw.

A very faint, soft cloud of dust drifts down from the ceiling for a moment, barely visible in the warm light. No debris, plaster, fragments, or rubble fall. The ceiling remains intact. The small Golden Emoji trophy stays completely still on the table at its current reduced size.

Keep all mouths fully closed for the entire shot. No lip movement, no speaking, no visible teeth. Natural blinking, subtle breathing, minimal body movement, realistic fabric motion, restrained acting.

Camera remains locked and stable with no zoom, pan, shake, or reframing. Cinematic realism, warm practical lighting, natural skin texture, subtle atmospheric dust.

Avoid: falling debris, cracking ceiling, exaggerated fear, sudden body jerks, comedy reactions, mouth opening, lip-sync, face morphing, trophy movement, object deformation, extra people, lighting changes, camera motion.
